integration: APPROVED TRIAL EXCEPTION: Preserve the five accepted tee states and accepted layer ordering exactly, including the byte-frozen approved bike0 grip. Do not apply these new masks to change accepted tee composites. For other body garments and new tee states, use exact-original foreground where body garment contributes alpha. For source-over rendering, first AND the selection mask with the union of garment alpha>0 to avoid double-compositing unchanged original semi-transparent pixels. Do not alpha-composite unrestricted duplicated source edges. Render neck/head accessories after restoration. Draw every layer at (0,0), and transform the whole group together.
scope: General exact-source anatomical parts: original head, face, horn, ears and foreground mane; torso and clothed upper legs excluded. Grip/forearm is a separate optional body-garment occlusion layer. Masks are not baked against a specific garment.
item_specific_tuning: Bike grip/forearm sleeve exits must be reviewed for each garment; the shared region is not an item-specific cuff contour.
Head/mane restoration cannot fix an incorrectly drawn collar or move a garment motif that was placed beneath the face.
Happy1 mane uses separate islands around raised arms; do not add the arms to this head/mane part.
No skateboard near-foreleg restoration added: inspected current tee requires no extra foreground leg.
Preserve source shadow rims at the anatomical boundaries; review restored collars at full resolution and gameplay size.

approved_trial_exception.rule: For accepted tee states, use the exact approved trial assets and draw order. Do not append shared head/mane restoration or replace the accepted bike0 foreground. The general head/mane parts remain available for OTHER body items at these poses.

qa.diagnostic_only_notice: Tee before/after diagnostic images demonstrate the generic selection, including the five accepted poses. They are not replacement approved tee composites.
